alerts.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 13 at 12:25PM MDT until October 15 at 8:00AM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...Thursday morning low temperatures in the mid 20s to lower
30s.

* WHERE...The San Luis Valley.

* WHEN...From midnight Wednesday Night to 8 AM MDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Freezing temperatures could kill crops, other sensitive
vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor plumbing.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...A killing freeze will be possible which could
bring an end to the growing season across the San Luis Valley.

* IMPACTS...Plan on slippery road conditions.

alerts.title: US 160 Pagosa Springs Reconstruction-147590
alerts.description: Between US 84 and Pike Drive (Pagosa Springs) from Mile Point 144.3 to Mile Point 141.8. Road construction. Starting October 13, 2026 at 7:00AM MDT until October 13, 2026 at about 6:00PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 13, 7:00AM - October 13, 6:00PM Comment: Harman Park & Piedra Road-Work is underway at this intersection of US 160. Working hours will be intermittent day and night so motorists should plan for potential delays, Monday-Saturday. Please allow extra time to get through the work zone. Safety benefits of this work includes pedestrian safety upgrades and ADA accessibility improvements. Expect lane shifts and up to 15-minute delays. Crews will switch two-way traffic into the eastbound lanes, perform temporary striping operations and begin asphalt milling in the westbound lanes. Parking will not be permitted on US 160 and vehicles will be towed at the owner's expense. Westbound lane closures, 10’ width and 75’ length restrictions will remain in place 24/7 through end of 2026. Work is weather-dependent. For questions contact the project team at 970-335-9230 or Pagosa160reconstruction@gmail.com Project Webpage: www.codot.gov/projects/us160pagosasprings
